gloss: not at all, not a bit

definitions.gloss: not at all, not a bit, not in the least
definitions.explanation: Used with negative predicates to emphasize complete absence or negation. Expresses stronger negation than あまり.

examples.japanese: ちっとも{分|わ}からない。
ちっとも{変|か}わっていない。
{何度|なんど}{練習|れんしゅう}しても、ちっとも{上手|じょうず}にならない。
examples.english: No matter how many times I practice, I don't get any better at all.

examples.japanese: {説明|せつめい}を{聞|き}いたのに、ちっとも{納得|なっとく}できなかった。
examples.english: Even though I heard the explanation, I wasn't convinced at all.

examples.japanese: あの{人|ひと}は{自分|じぶん}が{悪|わる}いのに、ちっとも{反省|はんせい}していないから、{周|まわ}りの{人|ひと}も{困|こま}っている。
examples.english: Even though he's in the wrong, he isn't reflecting on it at all, so the people around him are having a hard time too.

notes:
ちっとも is always used with negative predicates to emphasize negation.

GRAMMAR:
- ちっとも + negative verb/adjective
- Cannot be used with positive statements

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS (with negatives):
- {全然|ぜんぜん}〜ない: not at all (most common)
- ちっとも〜ない: not at all (emphatic)
- {少しも|すこしも}〜ない: not even a little
- {全く|まったく}〜ない: not at all (formal)

[Register: Casual to neutral]
